brief: Prioritise Willow Bend for pre-event attention because it is an ageing unit with a history of high loading [MG-023]. Where this unit cannot be attended before the forecast heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Ensure all outstanding work is re-prioritised against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat, completing work in categories 1 to 3 before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016].
